node.title: Rate-half distance-three dual row-product power router
node.statement: The exact external incidence design has a dual product identity: multiplying Q(z;x) over the 6e+3 active outside rows gives the monic external-slope polynomial to the power r=2e+1, up to the product of row-leading coefficients. Comparing this identity at the exceptional slope and an internal matched-pair slope forces product_C B(x)/D_i(x) to be an r-th power. This is a support-only finite-field power-residue gate, with a resultant and smooth-domain derivative evaluation requiring no slope, scalar, or block variables.
